title: dev-loop-defect review-rounds.json: the in-loop review history, one fingerprinted round per review
description: Written ONLY by .claude/skills/dev-loop-defect/scripts/review_rounds.py record (no model), through contracts/emit.py, to <evid_root>/<key>/review-rounds.json after every dev-code-review run in recipes 2 and 4. review.json is overwritten in place each fix cycle and holds no history; this file keeps one entry per distinct review.json (idempotent on its sha256) with the fingerprint of every finding still open. recipe_router.py --review-rounds reads it at the code-review stage and escalates with failure_class review-stagnation when one fingerprint is open in the last loop-limits.json review_convergence.stagnation_fix_cycles + 1 consecutive rounds. rounds_to_pass is the 1-based round of the first approve, null while none.

review_sha256.description: sha256 of the review.json bytes this round was recorded from; recording the same file twice adds no round.

attempt.description: The review.json's own `attempt`, when it carried one.

open.description: Every finding of that review that was not resolved:true and not withheld:true.

fingerprint.description: First 16 hex chars of sha256 over file + bug_class (basis class) or file + dimension + normalised issue text (basis text). The line is never part of it.

rounds_to_pass.description: The round number of the first approve round; null while no round has approved. The recipe writes it as the review_rounds_to_pass metric.

attempt.description: OPTIONAL. Which attempt of this stage produced the artifact, 1-based.

retry_reason.description: OPTIONAL. Why this attempt happened, when attempt > 1.

timing.description: OPTIONAL. When this file was written. review_rounds.py writes with --no-timing so the file is a pure function of the reviews recorded.
